description.describe_ch: 本課程主要內容包含三個主題，第一個主題介紹零售產業與環境分析；第二個主題討論零售經營管理；第三個主題則為零售行銷。該課程將提供零售管理之相關理論，並輔以個案教學。
description.describe_eh: This course includes 3 major topics. The first topic is the introduction to retailing and the retail environment analysis. The next topic will discuss retail operational management. The third topic mentions the issues of retail marketing. The course aims to set retailing activities into a marketing context and provide both theories and applications.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂上的行為始終應要及時、要專業、要做好準備、要有禮貌。同學、教師或其他講師間，應保有彼此尊嚴和相互尊重，才能進行有效的學習。為了確保有利於學習環境，冀望每個人都能做到以下幾點，彼此遵守課堂行為規則，習慣禮貌的文化。

學生應準時出席上課。如果您的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。 除非您生病或有緊急情況，否則應在上課前，要準時到達教室，並坐在位子上。如果您有某種原因必須提早下課，請提前告知我。
所有學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以合理、負責和禮貌的態度行事。
上課時請勿講話、閱讀、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除分組進行討論外，否則應盡量減少邊際對話。
當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。當您簡報時，您應該面對自己的小組或全班同學大聲說話，讓同學能聽清楚。
允許使用筆記型電腦或平板等載具，進行課堂記筆記，否則應將其收起。
要確保在上課時，關閉手機、PDA等移動設備，並收起及保持靜音。
不得戴耳機上課。
穿著整潔，不要暴露。
冀望以最高標準、互相尊重的專業對話模式，以多樣化和包容性，講述課程規則內容。
教師得以引導學生方式，學習過程中學生要做的事，應有的責任。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Behavior in the classroom should always be timely, professional, well prepared, and courteous. Effective learning can only be carried out if students, teachers or other lecturers maintain mutual dignity and respect. In order to ensure a conducive learning environment, everyone is expected to do the following: abide by the classroom behavior rules and develop a polite culture.

Students are expected to attend classes on time. If you cannot attend class on time, please do not select the course. Unless you are sick or have an emergency, you should arrive at the classroom on time and be seated before class starts. If you have to leave get out of class early for some reason, please let me know in advance.
All students are expected to respect everyone in the classroom and to behave in a reasonable, responsible and courteous manner at all times.
Please do not talk, read, sleep or do other non-course related work during class. Except for group discussions, side conversations should be kept to a minimum.
You should listen attentively when your classmates are giving presentations or asking questions. When you present, you should face your group or the whole class and speak loudly so that your classmates can hear you clearly.
Laptops or tablets are allowed for taking notes in class, but should be put away otherwise.
Make sure that mobile devices such as mobile phones and PDAs are turned off, put away and kept in silent mode during class.
Headphones are not allowed in class.
Dress neatly and don't expose yourself.
We hope to present the course rules and content in a professional dialogue model with the highest standards, mutual respect, diversity and inclusiveness.
Teachers are able to guide students in different ways and tell them what they should do and what responsibilities they should have during the learning process.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
學習必須以誠信為基礎，任何學生企圖將自己未製作的作品，作為自己的作品，此行為是為不誠實行為。
任何以您的名義提交的測試、論文或報告都被認為是您自己的原創作品，並且之前未曾在其他課程中提交過的作業、作品、或報告等，除非事先獲得我的批准。 在您的所有作業中，包括您的家庭作業或論文草稿，您可以引用其他人在出版物、網站或其他來源中撰寫的文字或想法，但必須註明出處。如果您對完成作業、或參加考試或考試的要求不清楚時，請務必事先向老師或TA尋求說明。最後，您應該記住，作為學生應該在所有學術活動中表現出誠信，完成學習任務。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Learning must be based on integrity. Any student attempting to present work that they did not produce as their own is committing an act of dishonesty.
Any test, paper, or report submitted under your name is considered to be your own original work and has not been previously submitted in another course unless approved by me in advance. In all your work, including your homework or essay drafts, you may quote words or ideas written by others in publications, websites, or other sources, but you must give citation to the source. If you are unclear about the requirements for completing an assignment, or taking a test or examination, be sure to seek clarification from your teacher or TA in advance. Finally, you should remember that as a student you are expected to demonstrate integrity in all your academic activities and complete your learning tasks.
